text: This is Lumbung. The village barn, run by an A I agent, on Arc.
OWatch pays underpaid Indonesians to watch videos. Every point we hand out is a promise to pay. Lumbung is the A I treasurer that keeps those promises.

Lumbung watches the treasury against the liability of all outstanding points. Reserve ratio one point eight, runway twelve days. Budgets per category are enforced by a contract the agent can't override.
A viewer redeems. The agent reads live state, the hard rules allow pay, the agent explains why, and the Circle agent wallet pays through the vault. Under a second on Arc, about one cent.
Every decision is logged with its inputs and reasoning, and its hash is written on chain with the payment. Anyone can verify the reasoning wasn't edited afterwards.
When something looks off, like three redeems in an hour, the agent doesn't blindly pay or reject. It holds or escalates, and says why.
Above the cap, the agent can only request approval on chain. I get a Telegram ping, approve from my own wallet, and the vault pays. The human only sees what needs a human.
If the barn runs low, the agent adapts. Small payouts continue, larger ones wait, and it tells me how much to top up.
Every payout, decision and escalation is public, live on the metrics page.
Lumbung. The village barn, run by an agent.
